acceptedAnswer.text: Multilingual forms are online forms that allow users to view and complete the form in their preferred language. Instead of creating separate forms for each language, one form can support multiple languages using AI translation.

mainEntity.name: How do multilingual forms work in Formester?

acceptedAnswer.text: You create your form in one primary language, select additional languages, and enable AI auto-translation. The system translates your form fields, labels, and messages instantly. Users can switch to their preferred language while filling out the form.

mainEntity.name: How accurate is the AI translation?

acceptedAnswer.text: AI translation provides high-quality, context-aware translations for most use cases. You can review and edit translated text to match your tone, industry terminology, or local preferences before publishing.

mainEntity.name: Can I add multiple languages to one form?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. You can add multiple languages to a single form. Users can select their preferred language from a language switcher, making the form accessible to a wider audience.

mainEntity.name: Will translation change my form design or layout?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Translation only affects text content such as labels, placeholders, and messages. Your layout, branding, and styling remain unchanged across all languages.

mainEntity.name: Do multilingual forms work on mobile devices?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Multilingual forms are fully responsive and work on desktops, tablets, and mobile devices. Users can switch languages easily on any screen size.

mainEntity.name: How do I share a multilingual form?

acceptedAnswer.text: You can share your multilingual form using a direct link, embed it on your website, or distribute it via email and social media. Users can choose their language after opening the form.

mainEntity.name: Can my team manage multilingual forms together?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. You can invite team members to edit, review, and manage translations. This helps maintain consistency across languages and ensures accurate messaging for global audiences.

components.markup:
Why this matters

Localized forms collect more responses. Here's the research.

Two numbers do most of the work for the multilingual decision.

+6 pp

Course completion rate after localization

A 90-day Articulate study found average course-completion rates rose from 77.4% to 83.4%, and median time-to-complete fell up to 50%. Forms behave the same way: when field labels read in the respondent's first language, abandonment drops at the field that previously confused them.

Source: Articulate, "How Does Localization Impact Training Outcomes? A 90-Day Study"
49.6%

Share of online content in English

English is 49.6% of online content but only ~17% of internet users are native English speakers. Mandarin is 1.2% of the internet against 1.1B+ speakers; Arabic is <0.5% against 310M speakers. Every form you ship in English alone is a form half your audience is rage-translating in their browser.

Source: LingoBright, Statista, 2026.

Languages

180+ languages. Including the ones that actually need extra work.

Most form builders that say "we support multiple languages" mean Latin-script European languages. The hard ones, right-to-left scripts, ideographic scripts, Indic scripts, are where translation tools fall apart. Formester handles all four families.

European & Latin (90+)
Spanish · French · German · Italian · Portuguese · Dutch · Polish · Romanian · Czech · Swedish · Norwegian · Finnish · Danish · Greek · Turkish · Russian · Ukrainian · plus 70+ more.
Latin, Cyrillic, and Greek scripts. Search by language name or country code.
Right-to-left (4)
العربية · עברית · فارسی · اردو
The form mirrors automatically: labels right-align, fields right-align, button order reverses, validation icons flip. No manual CSS.
CJK & East Asian (8)
中文 (简体) · 中文 (繁體) · 日本語 · 한국어 · Tiếng Việt · ไทย · Bahasa Indonesia · Bahasa Melayu
Unicode-compatible fonts fall back automatically. IME-friendly input.
Indic & African (50+)
हिन्दी · বাংলা · தமிழ் · తెలుగు · मराठी · ગુજરાતી · ਪੰਜਾਬੀ · ಕನ್ನಡ · മലയാളം · Kiswahili · isiZulu · አማርኛ · Hausa · Yorùbá · Igbo · plus 35+ more.
Devanagari, Bengali, Tamil scripts render correctly out of the box. Top 15 African languages by speaker count.

Verify before shipping: confirm RTL auto-mirroring and CJK font fallback with engineering. Soften any line that doesn't match production behavior.

Comparison

Formester vs Microsoft Forms vs Google Forms for multilingual

Microsoft Forms and Google Forms are where most multilingual-form searches start. Here's the honest delta.

Capability Formester Microsoft Forms Google Forms
Languages per form 180+ Up to 11 None native (browser-translate only)
AI-drafted translation Yes (Google Gemini) No, manual entry per language No
Edit AI draft per line Yes n/a (manual entry) n/a
Right-to-left script handling Automatic mirroring (Arabic, Hebrew, Persian, Urdu) Yes for supported subset Browser-dependent
Respondent language picker on form Yes Yes No (browser only)
Force language via URL or embed Yes (?lang= and data-lang) Limited No
One submissions table for all languages Yes, tagged by language Yes (consolidated) n/a
Free plan includes multilingual Yes Yes n/a

Microsoft Forms hits an 11-language ceiling per form; Google Forms relies on the respondent's browser to translate. If a form has to ship in more than a handful of languages, or has to render in Arabic or Hebrew, the choice gets straightforward. (See Microsoft Forms alternative · Google Forms alternative.)

Privacy and data

Your translations are yours. We don't train on them.

The form copy you write, the AI-generated translations, and the responses respondents submit are all Customer Data. Per Section 4.4 of our Data Processing Addendum, Formester does not use Customer Data to train AI models, run advertising, run analytics, or feed marketing. The Google Gemini integration that drafts the translations inherits the same boundary.

Your account is encrypted at rest, responses move over TLS, and payment data carries an additional AES-256 layer through Stripe. We are GDPR, UK GDPR, and CCPA compliant, with EU-resident processing available on the Business plan. We are not SOC 2, ISO 27001, or HIPAA certified yet, and we say so on the security page rather than implying otherwise.

title.text: Ready to build your perfect form?

faqList.body: Multilingual forms are online forms that allow users to view and complete the form in their preferred language. Instead of creating separate forms for each language, one form can support multiple languages using AI translation.

faqList.header: How do multilingual forms work in Formester?
faqList.body: You create your form in one primary language, select additional languages, and enable AI auto-translation. The system translates your form fields, labels, and messages instantly. Users can then switch to their preferred language while filling out the form.

faqList.header: How accurate is the AI translation?
faqList.body: AI translation provides high-quality, context-aware translations for most use cases. You can review and edit any translated text to match your tone, industry terminology, or local preferences before publishing.

faqList.header: Can I add multiple languages to one form?
faqList.body: Yes. You can add multiple languages to a single form. Users can select their preferred language from a language switcher, making the form accessible to a wider audience.

faqList.header: Will translation change my form design or layout?
faqList.body: No. Translation only affects text content such as labels, placeholders, and messages. Your layout, branding, and styling remain unchanged across all languages.

faqList.header: Do multilingual forms work on mobile devices?
faqList.body: Yes. Multilingual forms are fully responsive and work on desktops, tablets, and mobile devices. Users can switch languages easily on any screen size.

faqList.header: How do I share a multilingual form?
faqList.body: You can share your multilingual form using a direct link, embed it on your website, or distribute it via email and social media. Users can choose their language after opening the form.

faqList.header: Can my team manage multilingual forms together?
faqList.body: Yes. You can invite team members to edit, review, and manage translations. This helps maintain consistency across languages and ensures accurate messaging for global audiences.

faqList.header: What's the difference between multilingual forms and one form per language?
faqList.body: Multilingual forms are a single form with translations attached. The respondent picks their language and the labels, placeholders, errors, and thank-you page flip together. One submissions table holds all responses, tagged by the language the respondent chose. One form per language means N copies of the form to maintain, N edits every time you change a question, and N submissions tables to merge before reporting.

faqList.header: How long does it take to translate a form?
faqList.body: AI drafts every label, placeholder, validation message, and button as soon as you select a language. For a typical contact or feedback form (10–15 fields), the draft is ready in 5–10 seconds per language. You then edit any line that needs a tone fix. Two-language forms ship in under three minutes end to end; ten-language forms in under fifteen.

faqList.header: Can I edit the AI translation after it's generated?
faqList.body: Yes. Every translated line is editable. Click into any field on the translated language and overwrite the AI draft. The original English stays as the source of truth, so the next time you change a label, only the changed line needs re-checking. Translations you've edited are not overwritten by re-runs.

faqList.header: What language does the respondent see first when they open the form?
faqList.body: The form opens in the default language you set (usually the language the form was authored in). A language switcher sits at the top of the form so the respondent can switch to their preferred language with one tap. Browser-detection-based defaults are on the roadmap for now, you can also pre-select a language via a URL parameter (e.g., ?lang=es) for emails sent to a specific country segment.

180+ languages, including all major European languages (Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Dutch, Polish, Swedish), CJK (Chinese simplified and traditional, Japanese, Korean), right-to-left scripts (Arabic, Hebrew, Persian, Urdu), Indic (Hindi, Bengali, Tamil, Telugu, Marathi, Gujarati), Southeast Asian (Thai, Vietnamese, Indonesian, Malay, Tagalog), and African languages (Swahili, Zulu, Amharic). Search by language name or country code to find one quickly.

Right-clicking and letting Chrome translate the page works for reading but breaks form submission. Field validation messages stay in English. Required-field errors don't translate. Placeholder text often translates inconsistently. The submission lands in your dashboard with the field names mangled. A purpose-built multilingual form keeps validation, errors, and submission integrity intact in every language.

faqList.header: Is this on the Free plan?
faqList.body: Yes. AI translation, language picker, and respondent-language tagging are on the Free plan (unlimited forms, unlimited responses). Branding removal and conditional logic move you to Personal at $13/mo. API access and PDF exports are on Business at $49/mo. See pricing for details.
